export_balance.description: Set the lower bound of a technology's outflow to a technology's carrier export, for any technologies that can export carriers out of the system.

carrier_export.description: Carrier(s) produced by this technology that can be exported out of the system boundaries without having to go to a pre-defined `sink` (i.e., via a `demand` technology). Must be a subset of `carrier_out`.

export_max.description: If `carrier_export` is defined, limit the allowed export of produced carrier for a technology.
export_max.title: Maximum allowed carrier export

flow_export.description: The flow of a carrier exported outside the system boundaries by a technology per timestep.
flow_export.title: Carrier export

flow_out.description: The outflow of a technology per timestep, also known as the flow discharged (from `storage` technologies) or the flow received (by `transmission` technologies) on a link.
flow_out.title: Carrier outflow
flow_out.where: carrier_out AND not (one_way AND map_dim(nodes, link_from)==True)
